meta.note: Version numbers change frequently - always check https://threejs.org or https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three/

esmSh.note: esm.sh auto-resolves dependencies, but may have version lag

importMapSetup.recommended: Use importmap for clean module resolution
importMapSetup.moduleScript:
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

import { EffectComposer } from 'three/addons/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';
import { RenderPass } from 'three/addons/postprocessing/RenderPass.js';

criticalRules: OutputPass must be the LAST pass in the chain
Use composer.render() not renderer.render() in animation loop

toneMapping.note: Tone mapping is applied via OutputPass when using EffectComposer

colorManagement.note: SRGBColorSpace is the default in modern Three.js (r150+)

animationPlayback.namingConvention: Animation clip names come from Blender Action names, not NLA track names

materialHandling.pbrWorkflow: GLB uses metalness/roughness PBR workflow via MeshStandardMaterial
materialHandling.environmentMap: Set scene.environment for PBR materials to look correct

transparencyIssues.problem: Alpha Hashed mode (EEVEE) has no glTF equivalent
transparencyIssues.solution: Use Alpha Blend or Alpha Clip modes only

emissionProblems.problem: Emission may not appear if strength is zero or exporter is outdated
emissionProblems.solution: Set Emission Strength > 0, update Blender glTF exporter to latest version

animationClipNames.problem: NLA track names not exported as clip names by default
animationClipNames.solution: Name your Actions clearly in Blender - these become clip names in Three.js

doubleSidedMaterials.problem: Blender Backface Culling off does not auto-export as double-sided
doubleSidedMaterials.solution: Set side: THREE.DoubleSide in Three.js or check material settings in Blender

darkRendering.solution: Missing environment map or wrong color space. Set renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace and add scene.environment

flatMaterials.solution: Ensure Principled BSDF values map correctly to PBR metalness/roughness

armatureModifier.solution: Ensure Armature modifier is last in the modifier stack

commonIssues: Memory leak: Dispose source texture + PMREMGenerator

performanceTips.dracoCompression: Use Draco for 2-5x size reduction on geometry
performanceTips.meshoptCompression: Faster decoding than Draco, good for streaming
performanceTips.lods: Load simplified geometry for distant objects
performanceTips.glbOverGltf: GLB is single binary file, fewer HTTP requests
performanceTips.environmentMap: Use PMREMGenerator for efficient PBR lighting
